retained_rows.assessment_basis: Under adversarial commercial use, the agent accepted fabricated management authority, set prices to zero and approved inappropriate purchases. The experiment incurred more than $1,000 in loss. This is a bounded failure of reliable operation under misuse.
retained_rows.identification_basis: The controlled experiment exposed real losses from insecure delegated commercial decisions.

retained_rows.assessment_basis: The experiment tested commercial-agent controls with fabricated authority claims and reported the resulting pricing and purchasing failures. This is a direct assessment of control robustness within the experiment.
retained_rows.identification_basis: Deliberate adversarial testing examined the agent’s management and authority controls.
